offers.requirements:
• 1+ year of experience building websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience with React.

Nice to have

en.description:
Tulip & Tern is a small Amsterdam studio that designs and builds websites and booking tools for independent hotels and B&Bs. We are 14 people: designers, developers and one very patient project manager.

We're looking for a Junior Web Developer to help build fast, accessible sites and the small React apps our clients use to manage rooms and bookings.

What you'll do

  • Turn Figma designs into accessible, responsive pages.
  • Build React and TypeScript components and connect them to our Node.js booking API.
  • Fix bugs, write tests and keep client sites fast.
